profile_text.body:
UiPath describes itself as a platform for business orchestration and automation that brings together AI agents, automation, people, and systems on a single product. The company says its platform enables enterprises to transform operations by delivering secure, compliant outcomes at scale, with every action and decision captured in a complete business record to support governance and measurement of AI and automation results.

The company's primary product is UiPath AI, which combines robotic process automation with AI capabilities including document understanding and process mining for enterprise automation governance. UiPath positions this as purpose-built agentic solutions that orchestrate and automate critical business workflows, including dedicated capabilities for software testing across enterprises.

UiPath is a public company founded in 2005 and headquartered in New York, NY, trading under the ticker PATH. The company appears in 342 legal matters connected to New York.
